name: prose-lint
description: Runs the wording linters on a Japanese or English document and rules on every hit: textlint with Japanese and English configs (the kana rules of 内閣訓令 through prh and the hiragana rules, い抜き・さ入れ・フィラー, the AI-writing preset), a register of rejected wordings that you grow row by row (definition by negation, the spoken register, the stock phrases of generated Japanese), natural-japanese's lint with its naturalness score and baseline rerun, a sudachipy morphology lint (four checks from 公用文作成の考え方 and six house rules), an academic mode for Japanese papers, theses and reports (47 register rows of spoken or over-stiff wordings, each citing the university writing guides, lab guides and corpus studies it rests on, and two morphology checks), and vale with proselint, the ai-tells package and three house rules: two for the signs of LLM-written English and a comma cap for sentences strung on commas. The Japanese side also settles a style before any layer runs (what the document is, its reader, its 文体, and where its words come from), sends the document to a reader in a fresh context that finds translationese from a sourced reference, and runs a register of 13 translationese forms, each resting on a style guide or study and measured against 83 human-written documents. prose-lint is an independent project; proselint is a separate linter by other authors.
